name: Global Type Declarations
description: TypeScript type declarations for the IDE's global types: EditorState (open files, active file, cursor positions), WorkspaceState (plugin layout, zoom, pan), DirEntry (filesystem entry), EditorSelectionState (editor selection payload), and the Window.electronAPI interface exposing all IPC namespaces (window, clipboard, terminal, workspace, shell, prefs, git, fs, ide).

types.name: EditorState
types.description: Serializable editor state: openFiles (array of absolute paths), activeFile (currently focused tab), explorerWidth (split pane width in px), cursors (per-file cursor/scroll positions)

fields.name: cursors
fields.type: Record<string, { lineNumber: number; column: number; scrollTop: number }>

fields.name: plugins
fields.type: Array<{ uuid, title, x, y, width, height, isOpen, editorState? }>

types.name: DirEntry
types.description: Filesystem directory entry for tree rendering

types.name: EditorSelectionState
types.description: Editor selection payload broadcast to IDE clients via WebSocket

types.name: Window.electronAPI
types.description: Global window.electronAPI interface with all IPC namespaces exposed by the preload script

fields.name: terminal
fields.type: { create, write, resize, kill, onData, onExit }

fields.name: workspace
fields.type: { select, setPath, getPath, load, save, getRecent, addRecent, removeRecent }

fields.name: git
fields.type: { remotes, branches, checkout, log, showTree, diff, currentBranch, stagedFiles, unstagedFiles, stagedDiff, unstagedDiff, commitBody, stage, unstage, commit, push, checkAhead }

fields.name: fs
fields.type: { readDir, readFile, writeFile, mkdir, delete, copy, rename, watch, unwatch, onChanged }

lifecycle.created_by: TypeScript compiler (ambient declarations loaded at compile time)
